name: De Rosenroll 2026 DSGC with AIS and Dendritic-Spike Machinery
short_description: v3 extension of the t0078 AIS-augmented Bed B DSGC substrate adding dendritic Mg-block NMDA, distal Nav1.6 + NaP, and hard biological bounds on AIS Nav density.

entry_points.name: build_dsgc_cell_with_ais
entry_points.description: Build a DSGC cell with AIS extension; v3 substrate uses the same builder but with the 5 new dendritic-spike parameters in the v3 ParameterVector.

entry_points.name: apply_parameter_vector
entry_points.description: Write a 54-d v3 ParameterVector to all sections of the DSGC cell, including v3 distal Nav1.6 + NaP overlay on terminal dendrites.

entry_points.name: DSGCCellWithAIS
entry_points.description: Cell wrapper class re-exported from t0078; carries AIS sections and dendritic tier accessors.

entry_points.name: ParameterVector
entry_points.description: 54-d frozen dataclass with @property accessors for each parameter group, including the 5 v3 dendritic-spike parameters (gnmda_dend, mg_conc_mm, voff_nmda, nav16_dend_distal, nap_dend_distal).

entry_points.name: BedBV3Problem
entry_points.description: pymoo Problem subclass with n_var=54, n_obj=2, n_ieq_constr=1 (AIS-to-soma Nav ratio constraint per Werginz 2024).

entry_points.name: run_nsga2_loop
entry_points.description: Main entry-point for the NSGA-II MOBO loop on the v3 substrate; arms a cost-cap watchdog that exits cleanly on $2.00 hard cap trip.

entry_points.name: evaluate_parameter_vector
entry_points.description: Run a single 8 directions x 20 seeds evaluation of one parameter vector; returns DSI / PD rate / stability flag.
